reason: Plan v1 implements the approved specification with one plain global stylesheet (src/styles.css), imported from src/main.tsx through Vite. It adds no new dependencies or external resources. The look is editorial: a paper-and-ink palette with a deep-red accent, system serif display and body stacks with sans-serif kicker labels, a 48rem reading column and thin rules between tasks. Markup changes are limited to added class names, and no wrapper elements are added, because the SDLC-13 unit test requires the controls to share one parent. Each of AC1 to AC12 maps to a computed-style Playwright test in a new e2e/styling.spec.ts, which uses a small WCAG contrast helper. AC13 is covered by the existing unit and e2e suites passing unmodified. No ADR was needed, and there was no related work or notes to apply.
